All eight used ground receivers and both slope fills were inspected in literal 3x3 repetitions. New/retained props were inspected on summer workyard/paving. C5 introduces no seasonal exports: seasonal-ground and summer/winter mask tests are not applicable. All 42 red/slate/brown alpha comparisons are pixel-identical. Replayed all 57 retained image-tool drawing reductions:25,692,160 registered RGBA samples, with exact 64-vote modes and source hashes matching. These processing passes do not validate the failed composition/material masks. Regenerated the final in memory without writing production outputs; its bytes match the saved image. Verified exact 2x, greyscale, all three 3x crops and all three native comparison panels. Storey histogram from 41 modular buildings:1=3,2=15,3=11,4=8,5=4 (7.32% one-storey). Inclusive ancillary count 49:1=10,2=16,3=11,4=8,5=4 (20.41%). Civic/defensive landmarks and attached porch/toll bay are separate. Roof mix 20 terracotta/13 slate/8 brown (48.78% terracotta). No frontage lawns observed in the final. The actual final, retained E L-block/market/height layouts and current C5 L/T layout pass the resolved-piece audit. The former E rear-cap/eight-trade-shop defects and the first C5 proof-cap repetition are not repeated as current failures. All eight trade symbols are nameable at 1x; three vendor silhouettes are used twice each. FIXES disposition:1 partial/fail (short caps and opaque fills repaired; assembled filled cap/abutments fail);2 partial/fail (pitch retained and outline suppression improved, but added join geometry still exposes an extra tab/return);3 fail (cap-specific receiving-wall/flashing continuity);4 partial/fail (mixed block roof families retained, but filled-cap texture and slate facade masks fail);5 partial (ground-aligned yards improved; connected L/rear-wing proof remains inadequate);6 fail (new inhabited bays provided, but side-door orientation/anchors do not demonstrate the required lane entries);7 addressed (10x7 notched square, church west, guildhall north, inn east, hall south, six stalls and fountain/cross);8 partial/fail (churchyard/human scale improved, east porch perspective/entry not resolved);9 addressed (quiet slabs, pale main road, differentiated courts; old tile frames repaired);10 partial/fail (unioned height-responsive shadows improved, fountain contact fails);11 substantially addressed (new curtain bodies, shoulders, stair and gate contacts present; no obsolete oversized-patch failure retained);12 addressed (recognisable mounted signs and recessed bays);13 addressed (bottles/mortar, boots/leather and cloth goods now distinct);14 partial/fail (inn repaired, new side entries remain inadequate);15 partial/fail (mixed real roof forms and height counts pass, new side colour masks/roof joins do not);16 addressed in the authored scene (three vendors, customers, loading cart/porter, seated visitor and gate guard; stationary actors included by the saved-art verifier);17 addressed (low southern houses, yards/sheds and forge);18 addressed (bench/shrine destinations and an actual guard noticeboard);19 substantially addressed (stair/access, gate groove and repaired human-scale toll bay);20 fail (visibly broken compatible-join and directional-access proofs; L/rear-wing construction still not established). BRIEF-17 takes precedence over conflicting panel proposals: this verdict does not demand smaller signs, larger gate footprint, deeper principal lots, cross-lot overlays or waiver of street variation. The coordinator 40x30 native-cell requirement justifies 1920x1440. The actual plan was reworked; this is not a claim that only colours changed. No runtime collision/pathfinding test or independent panel approval is claimed. Verdict remains fail because the named visible defects would require a redraw or composition repair.
